hook: That water on your seat isn't from the roof.
standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.visual: A water droplet swelling and falling from the fabric headliner corner inside a dim car cabin, a dark damp stain spreading through the fabric, shallow focus, no people
beats.narration: Water dripping from the headliner after rain?

beats.visual: Cutaway of a sunroof tray channel with a thin rubber drain tube running down inside the pillar, clean water tracing through the tube, cool workshop lighting
beats.narration: Sunroofs drain through four tubes in the pillars.

beats.visual: Macro at the mouth of a drain tube packed with wet leaf litter and pine needle mush, water pooling and backing up in the tray around it
beats.narration: Leaves pack one shut and water backs up.

beats.visual: Rain beading and running down the glass above, then the headliner fabric below going dark with damp at one corner, flat grey daylight
beats.narration: One clue is it only happens after rain.

beats.visual: A rubber drain tube laid on a steel shop bench with clear water running freely out of its end, warm work lamp, no hands
beats.motion: slow push-in on the open end
beats.narration: Clearing a drain beats chasing a roof seal.

phrasesUsed: stop by and we'll take a look

evidence.note: General automotive mechanism knowledge only, not a sourced businessFacts/EvidenceRecord claim. reel/social is not yet a FactChannel in this repo.
